versions.changelog: No user-visible changes in this version; no file changes detected.

Initial release of Cluster Upgrade Planner – a tool to plan Kubernetes cluster upgrades with confidence.

- Detects deprecated and removed API usage across the cluster.
- Verifies addon and workload compatibility with target Kubernetes version.
- Checks for upgrade blockers and workload disruption risks via preflight report.
- Generates step-by-step, rollback-safe upgrade runbooks tailored to cluster type.
- Assesses node readiness and estimates upgrade timing and risk.
